title: Pack FR1 - First-run onboarding journey verification catalog

notes: Verification ledger for the four first-run onboarding scenarios (fast-start, customize walk, abandon/resume, channel fallback). Wired into the check-lifeops-persona-catalog-coverage.mjs EXPECTED_CATALOGS gate under the row-evidence contract: every verified row carries a structured evidence receipt (model, judge, judgeScore, pointer, artifactReceipt).

Scope of the claim, stated precisely: first-run is conductor-driven, not model-invocable — the production in-chat conductor lives in the client (packages/ui/src/first-run/), which a headless runner cannot exercise. Each scenario therefore splits the proof: LIVE judged message turns show the model engaging with the surfaced firstRunProvider affordance (trajectory evidence), while the final check drives the real FirstRunService through the PRODUCTION scheduled-task runner (the same seam the conductor uses) and asserts the persisted app_lifeops.life_scheduled_tasks rows via LifeOpsRepository. These rows are DOMAIN-CONTRACT proofs of FirstRunService + the persisted store, NOT an end-to-end UI onboarding-journey proof; the conductor UI leg is client e2e territory.

PR #15016's earlier live evidence is deliberately NOT back-filled here: it recorded no judge scores and attached no report JSON/JSONL, so these rows verify only from current-SHA runs with full artifacts.

scenarios.notes: Fast-start (defaults) path. Verification must show the default pack (gm/gn/checkin/morning-brief) materialized in the real scheduled-task store with the gm cron anchored to the answered wake time, plus judged live turns engaging the onboarding affordance.

Customize path under the three-question contract (#14691: name, categories, channel; timezone/windows volunteered or inferred). Verification must show the seeded pack anchored to the volunteered morning window and the preferred name persisted.
Abandon mid-customize then resume. Verification must show resume advances to the first unanswered question (no re-asking), partial answers survive, and the flow still reaches the seeded pack.
Unconnected channel choice (telegram) must record fallbackToInApp with a surfaced warning and a '(fallback)' completion message, and the pack must still seed.
